Home / About

The Art of Everyday Leather

Since the first cut

Craftsmanship over convenience

Vareno began with a simple frustration: most "premium" leather goods were neither. We set out to build essentials — belts, wallets, bags — using full-grain hides, solid brass hardware, and construction meant to outlast trends.

Every piece is inspected by hand before it leaves our workshop. We'd rather make fewer things and make them right.

Craftsmanship

Cut, skived, and stitched by hand in small batches.

Quality

Full-grain hides sourced from responsible tanneries.

Timeless Design

Silhouettes built to outlast seasonal trends.

Durability

Reinforced stitching and solid brass hardware throughout.

Home / Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Vareno collects only the information required to process your order and improve your shopping experience — name, contact details, shipping address, and payment information handled by our processor.

We never sell your personal data to third parties. Information is used strictly for order fulfilment, customer support, and — with your consent — occasional newsletter updates.

You may request a copy of your data or ask us to delete it at any time by contacting hello@vareno.com.

Home / Terms & Conditions

Terms & Conditions

By placing an order with Vareno, you agree to provide accurate information and to our pricing, which is subject to change without notice ahead of order confirmation.

All product photography is representative; natural variation is expected in genuine leather goods. Unauthorized resale of Vareno products under the Vareno name is prohibited.

Continued use of this site constitutes acceptance of these terms.

Home / Shipping & Returns

Shipping & Returns

Shipping

Standard delivery takes 5–7 business days; express delivery arrives in 1–2 business days. Orders over $75 ship free. International shipping is available to most countries at checkout.

Returns

Unused items in original condition may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Personalized items are final sale.
